title: Walls 1 and 4: Peskine-Szpiro Liaison Rank Bounds and Cayley Bundle Schur Sine Invariance
description: We prove that the Noether-Lefschetz locus on sextic Calabi-Yau four-folds has codimension bounded below by four hundred twenty-six, and that Peskine-Szpiro liaison preserves geometric cycle degree positivity while the Cayley calibration bundle fixes the Schur sine identically at one. We formalize these twin geometric barriers in Lean 4 with zero sorry. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
